headline: Iran says US naval blockade prevents it from importing gasoline - Ensegundos Dominican Republic
summary: Iran said the US naval blockade of its ports is preventing gasoline imports while domestic production does not cover consumption. The statement was reported by Ensegundos.do.
why: Iran is a major oil producer with a large domestic fuel market, so shortages or import blocks shape regional refined-product supply and prices.
